wikipedia.title: McCoy Solar Energy Project
wikipedia.extract:
The McCoy Solar Energy Project is a 250 megawatt (MWAC) photovoltaic power plant near the city of Blythe in  Riverside County, California.

It occupies about 2,300 acres (930 ha) of mostly public land in the Mojave Desert.  The construction uses CdTe thin film panels from First Solar,  and the output is being sold to Southern California Edison under a power purchase agreement.
The project is located adjacent to the 235 MW Blythe Solar Energy Center, together forming a larger 485 MW complex.  The 550 MW Desert Sunlight Solar Farm is located approximately 40 miles (64 km) west in Riverside County.
